### When formed understanding can correct its source

The whole account needs a positive connection from good realized in a shared activity to the reasons governing its continuation. **Understanding formed through guidance can require correction of a particular aim before it removes the need for guidance generally.** This gives differentiated development an actual role in what the process becomes, without making its initiating position the permanent owner of its warrant.

Consider a mathematical apprenticeship whose independently defended point is truthful inquiry. A mentor proposes establishing a conjecture; the learner develops a verified counterexample within the same domain and interpretation. For a concrete arithmetic illustration, the conjecture that `n² + n + 41` is prime for every natural `n` fails at `n = 40`, where its value is `1681 = 41 × 41`. This is an elementary illustration, not a new mathematical result or an observed teaching case.

The learner can still need extensive guidance about generalization, proof, resources and communication. Nevertheless, the valid correction changes what this practice can responsibly seek to establish. The mentor's greater competence elsewhere and the learner's dependent role do not restore the defeated conjecture. The mentor may retain it as an explicitly false conjecture for an exercise; that changes the purpose rather than vindicating the original truth claim.

The positive relation is that the shared activity has formed understanding whose exercise can now correct that activity. Where guidance was justified by enabling such understanding, excluding its valid consequence solely to protect the initial aim frustrates the very good offered as the guidance's ground. A practice can instead realize that good through acknowledgment, reassessment and a changed inquiry while retaining other justified guidance. The reason comes from the actual relationship between understanding, its object and the shared undertaking; no private return to either participant is required.

Several distinctions make this a bounded argument. Being correct here does not confer general expertise, unilateral decision power, public credit or permission to use every implementation method. Institutional procedures can govern verification and subsequent action; other people and obligations remain relevant. A rival defending hierarchy or disciplined performance on another ground must state and justify it. The present argument defeats a role-based dismissal under the stated truth-oriented ground, rather than every possible account of authority.

The [argument](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-ARGUMENT.md#8-continuation-formed-understanding-can-correct-its-source), [review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md#7-continuation-correction-before-general-independence) and [genealogy](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-SCOPE.md#6-continuation-formed-correction-and-its-remaining-ground) credit the existing content-consistency and successful-support results. The extension concerns locally warranted influence arising before general independence. It explains a practical consequence of a defended relational good; it does not derive that good's ethical worth from arithmetic or generic formation. Ethical applications must independently establish the alleged good, the correction and the scope of authority. In contested cases, calling a new purpose enlightened would not establish any of these.

## Continuation: formed understanding and differentiated authority

The [new argument §8](WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-ARGUMENT.md#8-continuation-formed-understanding-can-correct-its-source) investigates a positive interface: **a defended good of shared activity → understanding formed within it → a reason to revise a particular aim while other justified guidance remains**. A verified correction can acquire its appropriate practical relevance before its contributor becomes generally independent. This makes the formation of differentiated capacities consequential to the practice's direction, rather than treating the initial distribution of authority as permanently fixed.

The mathematical-apprenticeship illustration fixes the conjecture and its domain; a concrete composite value refutes its universal prime claim. That evidence can defeat the aim of establishing the claim as true while leaving much teaching and decision authority intact. The correction does not itself allocate resources, decide a replacement project or create a right to every proposed form of implementation. Actual verification and the authority to act remain distinct. No proof assistant or new mathematical discovery is claimed.

The [review](WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md#7-continuation-correction-before-general-independence) accepts this inference under the independently defended good and authority scope. It preserves the stronger rival that openly justifies hierarchy or some other end. The [scope note](WHOLE-PROCESS-GROUNDING-SCOPE.md#6-continuation-formed-correction-and-its-remaining-ground) traces Ren's reason-oriented cooperation and materially supported plurality to human source messages, while keeping the archived plan's explicit normative commitment visible. None is converted into a proof that every generated purpose is worthwhile or that domination must collapse.

Existing participation/content-consistency work and the successful-support argument already supply the general pattern. This continuation's narrower contribution is local corrective warrant before general independence. It is an ethically relevant application of a warranted shared good, not a replacement for deriving the good itself. The whole foundation still needs to establish why its proposed realization, agency and repair relations possess their claimed ethical significance and scope.

The previous goal turn was progress: it integrated the two repair comparisons and the conditional count-order objection. This turn develops the positive formed-correction interface and preserves the unresolved ultimate grounding. The active objective is unchanged; completion of this bounded argument does not complete it.

## 8. Continuation: formed understanding can correct its source

**Successful formation can change warranted influence before it ends dependence.** This supplies a positive conditional connection to practical significance: understanding formed through a shared activity can legitimately correct that activity's aim. It does not derive worthwhileness from formation alone, or treat a newly acquired preference as self-validating.

Consider a conceptual mathematical apprenticeship. Its independently defended point is to understand and communicate what is true; initial guidance is justified partly by greater relevant competence. The operative aim is to establish conjecture P. For a self-contained illustration, let P say that n² + n + 41 is prime for every natural n: n = 40 gives 1681 = 41². The learner produces a verified counterexample under the same declared domain and interpretation. They still need guidance in choosing a replacement problem, proving generalizations and presenting results. The practice has formed a route to an actual ground for correction without making its participants equally competent in every respect.

The contribution changes more than a method of pursuing P. Establishing P as true must cease to be the operative aim under the stated undertaking. The counterexample's force comes from what it establishes, not from the mentor's private endorsement or the learner's desire for independence. The mentor may retain P as an explicitly false conjecture for an exercise. That changes the activity; it does not establish P as true.

Three supplied premises support the inference. Truthful inquiry is worthwhile in this practice. The particular authority being challenged is grounded in competence and support for that inquiry within a specified scope. The learner's correction is genuinely warranted. **The earlier role difference therefore cannot, by itself, defeat this correction or warrant presenting P as established.** The learner can be less capable overall while contributing the decisive consideration here; superior competence elsewhere does not repair the mentor's error here.

This is a local change in justified evidential influence, not a transfer of every decision power. Selecting the next inquiry, allocating resources and publishing remain subject to their actual responsibilities and permissions. Independent verification can be appropriate. A warranted correction may call for shared reassessment rather than immediate unilateral action. Protection of novices, non-speaking affected lives and other participants cannot depend solely on who can produce an argument. Their grounds remain distinct.

The positive whole-process proposal concerns the actual exercise of the understanding formed. The activity now contains a contribution capable of reshaping what it should become; accommodating that contribution can realize a joint understanding through differentiated roles. Appropriation occurs in the tested respect when the capacity is welcomed only as an instrument of the old aim, while its valid correction is excluded solely to preserve that aim. The arrangement then withholds the influence of the understanding whose formation supported its guidance. Recognizing this difference requires neither independent owners of value nor treating every newly formed purpose as good.

The preserved higher good matters. This is revision of a proximate aim under truthful inquiry, not an explanation of the origin or validity of every standard. A rival may openly prize hierarchy, performance or another purpose over this inquiry, or establish a further legitimate restriction. The argument then requires that changed ground to be assessed; it has not proved universal non-domination or every being's ethical standing. Invalid evidence or a misidentified authority scope would also revise the application.

[Participation analysis §11.2](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN.md) and [direction analysis §2](YITI-REN-DIRECTION-ARGUMENT.md#2-从具体活动取得条件不能由条件替它创造意义) already establish content consistency. [The support study §54](HUIGEN-SELF-GROUND-AUDIT.md#54-successful-support-and-continuing-commitments) already shows success changing a rationale without ending every undertaking. The narrower extension here concerns locally decisive understanding **before full independence**, and its appropriate influence amid continuing guidance. The worth of understanding in shared activity is a substantive premise, not a private preference or a completed ethical foundation. No formal or empirical result is added.

## 7. Continuation: correction before general independence

The next positive interface is narrower than universal non-appropriation: **understanding formed through warranted guidance can require revising a particular aim before the learner becomes generally independent.** The practice changes its own grounds of guidance through what it enables. Descriptive plurality alone does not establish this conclusion; the activity's worth, the relevance of the understanding and the scope of authority remain explicit premises.

Consider a mathematical apprenticeship whose independently warranted purpose includes establishing and communicating a true result. The mentor selects a conjecture P over a specified domain. Through the practice, the novice develops a counterexample that is checked and valid for that same conjecture and domain. This is neither a novel opinion nor a counterexample to a silently altered claim. The mentor may remain more knowledgeable overall, with legitimate responsibility for training, resources and publication.

The valid counterexample defeats the target of establishing P as true. Preserving that target solely because its proposer is the mentor cannot restore its warrant. A revised conjecture, a refutation or ending this inquiry are possible responses; the learner's discovery does not choose among them. Here correction concerns the proximate aim—what is to be established—not just a more efficient proof method. The higher purpose of truthful inquiry remains granted rather than newly generated.

This distinguishes the correction's force from authority to implement a response. Validation can legitimately require checking, appropriate expertise and time. A learner's insistence does not make a counterexample valid. Once the stated validation condition holds, however, remaining dependence in other matters cannot by itself defeat this correction. Publication rules or valid curricular decisions may still govern subsequent action. Investigating P as an explicitly identified false-conjecture exercise can be worthwhile, but changes the activity; it does not establish P as true.

The [existing content test, §11.2](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN.md) and [direction argument §2](YITI-REN-DIRECTION-ARGUMENT.md) already show that violating an activity's necessary conditions defeats its claimed realization. [Successful support §54](HUIGEN-SELF-GROUND-AUDIT.md#54-successful-support-and-continuing-commitments) already distinguishes changed grounds from disappearance of every commitment. The present application connects these results before general independence: relevant understanding can arise unevenly, changing one instructional ground while other guidance remains justified. It neither discovers content consistency nor proves an equal distribution of decision power.

The positive whole-level interpretation is that developed understanding can actually help determine what shared activity becomes. Keeping its source in the apprentice role does not make that understanding cease to matter to the specified inquiry. This warrants a local correction without requiring a private return or an outside meaning-giver. It does not establish the activity's moral worth from mathematics. An honest hierarchy rival may defend another purpose or additional authority; those grounds require appraisal rather than dismissal by title. Applying this result to contested ethical aims requires independently defending what counts as a correction, not importing the preferred verdict into that word. No new formal theorem, empirical finding or universal ethical necessity is claimed.

## 6. Continuation: formed correction and its remaining ground

Ren's direct **HUMAN, 5 May 2026, 08:27** [message](../../../../sources/12-claude-ai-chats/2026-05-05_古文一元论与语言的逻辑收敛_2954cf42.md) connects a common root with plurality and contrasts cooperation answering to reasons with competition answering to victory. His **HUMAN, 16 April 2024, 15:40** [proposal](../../../../sources/12-claude-ai-chats/2024-04-16_Balancing_AI_risks_and_opportunities_through_harmonious_coex_4995bbc7.md) calls for materially supported alternative lives and preventing power convergence. These are original proposals; their asserted adaptive and favorable tendencies are not established inevitabilities. They cannot exclude sustainable domination by definition.

The archived [v2 plan §§2.3, 5.3–5.4](../../../../sources/06-zhishan/shengsheng/生生不息论v2/PLAN-v2.md#23-元伦理立场) develops effective standing as a source of reasons and materially regenerable alternatives. It explicitly identifies a normative commitment and admits a consistent dominator's refusal. This draft development is not Ren's verbatim speech or a completed derivation; its premise need not be ontologically outside generation to remain explanatorily supplied.

The [participation argument §11.2](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN.md#11-仁感应理解与实践一体的实现偏蔽与复通) and [direction argument §2](YITI-REN-DIRECTION-ARGUMENT.md#2-从具体活动取得条件不能由条件替它创造意义) already distinguish fulfilling an independently identified activity from legitimating its purpose. [Successful support §54](HUIGEN-SELF-GROUND-AUDIT.md#54-successful-support-and-continuing-commitments) already distinguishes changed fulfillment, authorized revision and amendment while a relationship continues.

The present bounded extension investigates **local corrective warrant before general independence**: a developing participant can acquire a justified correction of one shared aim while still properly relying on guidance elsewhere. Earlier inexperience cannot by itself defeat that acquired warrant. This does not infer directive power from knowledge, authorize every objection, or erase independent grounds for hierarchy and continuing commitments. Its advance concerns the selective reassessment of a formed authority's justification; it does not establish the ultimate ethical authority of all jointly formed purposes.

Reading scope: the specified original HUMAN messages, selected archival plan passages and current argument sections were inspected. No external doctrinal claim, empirical confirmation or new universal proof is added.
